description: `relative_memberships` carries confirmed current/deceased relative membership scoped to one exact target credit union; one institution is never reused for another. `next_questions.unlocks_cu_count` counts membership decisions an answer may clarify, never guaranteed products. Discovery tool: find candidate credit unions a person may be able to JOIN, from their own facts rather than from a list of institutions. Pass any combination of home, worksite, or payroll geography (these are independent), occupation, employer, school (+school_relationship), associations, military_status, and worship; at least one discriminating fact is required, or pass willing_to_join_association=true as the sole discriminator to search documented joinable-association paths. City facts require their same-role state or a recognized same-role ZIP that uniquely identifies one state, and are accepted only when the closed Census gazetteer resolves them. This evaluates a bounded, prioritized candidate set, not the entire credit-union fleet: read `candidate_limit`, `candidate_set_truncated`, and `candidate_sources`, and never interpret an absent institution as unavailable or ineligible. Returns four buckets within that candidate set — eligible (a verified path already applies), conditionally_eligible (one more step, e.g. joining an association, with the cost and join URL when known), possibly_eligible (a path may apply but a requirement could not be confirmed), and unknown (we could not decide — either we hold no rules for the institution or the supplied facts cannot decide the rules we hold). Every non-positive entry carries a machine-readable `unknown_reason`: `geo_inputs_missing` / `org_inputs_missing` / `inputs_missing` mean ONE MORE FACT FROM THE USER would resolve it, so ask for it and call again; `no_rules` means we hold nothing for that institution and asking will not help; `incomplete_fom`, `fom_completeness_unaffirmed`, `low_confidence_rules` and `unmodeled_condition` mean we hold rules but will not turn a failure against them into a no. Each entry also carries `coverage` — {state, rules_held, last_confirmed_at, fom_affirmed} — describing what we HOLD about the institution as opposed to what we concluded about the person. Each entry carries the credit union id, name, state, confidence, and deterministic reasons. Use this to find supported candidates; use check_membership_eligibility when you already have specific credit_union_ids. Credit unions are never listed as ineligible — absence of evidence is never treated as evidence of absence, and the final membership determination is always the institution's. Every non-positive entry now also carries `missing_facts`: the exact question to ask the person next, the `fact_field` their answer populates, why it matters, and the institution's own words. The response's top-level `next_questions` ranks those questions across all institutions by how many they unlock — ASK THE TOP ONE TO THREE, MERGE THE ANSWERS INTO THE SAME REQUEST BODY, AND CALL AGAIN. Two or three turns is the intended shape of this tool; a single call is a first draft. Stop when `next_questions` is empty, when the top entry's `unlocks_cu_count` is below 2, or after three turns. `unanswerable` lists what no question can fix — institutions we hold no rules for, boundaries we can state but not decide (census tracts, school districts, a radius around an office the page never identifies), and rule sets whose completeness nobody affirmed; do not ask the user about those. Fact fields, in full — supply every one you know: `home_zip`, `home_state`, `home_county`, `home_city`; `work_zip`, `work_state`, `work_county`, `work_city`; `payroll_zip`, `payroll_state`, `payroll_county`, `payroll_city` (payroll can differ from the worksite and is a separate door); `property_zip`, `property_state`, `property_county`, `property_city` (where they OWN property — never inferred from where they live, and an absentee owner qualifies); `facility_zip`, `facility_state`, `facility_county`, `facility_city` (where their business maintains a location); `occupation`; `employer`; `school` plus `school_relationship` (student/alumni/employee — a school name without a relationship affirms nothing); `associations`; `military_status` plus `military_service_state` (state National Guard doors need the state); `worship`; `family_relation` plus `relative_employers`, `relative_schools`, `relative_associations` (a great many people qualify only through a relative — ask); `willing_to_join_association`; `applicant_kind` (person/trust/organization/partnership/corporation — some charters admit entities, and a person is never rejected by an entity-only door, only left unknown); and `asserted_org_qualifiers` (narrowings the person asserts about themselves, e.g. "assigned as a recruiter in Arkansas").

applicant_kind.description: What the applicant IS. Some charters admit entities as well as people. Absent means a natural person; a person is never rejected by an entity-only door, only left unknown.

asserted_org_qualifiers.description: Narrowings the user asserts about themselves, quoted back from a missing_facts question (e.g. "assigned as Recruiters or ROTC Instructors within the State of Arkansas"). Absence caps a narrowed door rather than closing it.

association_org_ids.description: Canonical association ids selected through resolve_eligibility_entities; each is type- and publication-revalidated.

associations.description: Associations, unions, or member organizations the user already belongs to.

employer.description: User's employer, resolved to a canonical organization for SEG matching.

employer_org_ids.description: Canonical employer ids selected through resolve_eligibility_entities. The API revalidates entity type and active-publication authority before use.

facility_city.description: Census-recognized city where the user's business maintains a location. Requires facility_state or a recognized facility_zip that uniquely identifies one state.

facility_county.description: County where the user's business maintains a location.

facility_state.description: State where the user's business maintains a location.

facility_zip.description: ZIP where the user's business maintains a location. Distinct from the worksite ZIP.

family_relation.description: How the user relates to a RELATIVE whose own affiliations may qualify them (e.g. 'spouse', 'child', 'immediate family'). Required alongside relative_employers/relative_schools/relative_associations — without it there is nobody for those organizations to belong to. Many SEG lists read 'Employees of the following companies AND THEIR IMMEDIATE FAMILIES are eligible'; this is how that door is answered.

home_city.description: User's Census-recognized home city. Requires home_state or a recognized home_zip that uniquely identifies one state; unresolved labels are rejected rather than guessed.

home_county.description: User's county. Wins over the ZIP-derived counties when supplied.

home_state.description: User's valid 50-state/DC code (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Lowercase is accepted and normalized.

home_zip.description: User's US 5-digit home ZIP or ZIP+4. Resolves to candidate counties; when home_state is supplied, the crosswalk must agree with it.

military_service_state.description: The state the user serves, or served, in. State National Guard doors ("Oklahoma National Guard") need this; without it such a door reads unknown.

military_status.description: User's military affiliation, matched against military fields of membership.

occupation.description: User's occupation, matched against trade, industry, and profession fields of membership.

payroll_city.description: Census-recognized city from which payroll is issued. Requires payroll_state or a recognized payroll_zip that uniquely identifies one state.

payroll_county.description: County from which the user's employer issues payroll; distinct from work_county.

payroll_state.description: State from which the user's employer issues payroll; distinct from work_state.

payroll_zip.description: ZIP from which the user's employer issues payroll; distinct from the worksite ZIP. When payroll_state is supplied, the ZIP must agree with it.

property_city.description: Census-recognized city where the user owns real property. Requires property_state or a recognized property_zip that uniquely identifies one state.

property_county.description: County where the user owns real property. Distinct from home_county.

property_state.description: State where the user owns real property. Distinct from home_state.

property_zip.description: ZIP where the user OWNS REAL PROPERTY. A door of its own — never inferred from where they live, and an absentee owner qualifies.

relative_association_org_ids.description: Canonical association ids for the relative named by family_relation, never for the applicant.

relative_associations.description: Associations the RELATIVE named by family_relation belongs to. Optional; same unknown-by-default contract as relative_employers.

relative_employer_org_ids.description: Canonical employer ids for the relative named by family_relation, never for the applicant.

relative_employers.description: Employers of the RELATIVE named by family_relation (not the user's own employer). Optional; omitting it leaves compound family doors undecided (unknown), never negative.

relative_memberships.description: Confirmed relative memberships scoped to one exact credit union. A membership at one institution is never reused for another; omit unconfirmed memberships and the corresponding family door remains unknown.

credit_union_id.description: The exact target credit union id.

relation.description: The relative's relationship to the applicant.

relative_school_org_ids.description: Canonical school ids for the relative named by family_relation, never for the applicant.

relative_schools.description: Schools the RELATIVE named by family_relation attends. Optional; same unknown-by-default contract as relative_employers.

school.description: User's school/college/university, resolved to a canonical organization. Supply school_relationship too; a name alone is not a positive match.

school_org_ids.description: Canonical school ids selected through resolve_eligibility_entities; never populate these from prose extraction.

school_relationship.description: How the user relates to the school. Required with school to affirm a typed student, alumni, or school-employee path.

willing_to_join_association.description: Set true to search documented joinable-association paths (valid as the sole discriminator). Set false only to suppress paths that require joining an association; false alone is not a discriminating search fact.

work_city.description: Census-recognized city where the user works. Requires work_state or a recognized work_zip that uniquely identifies one state.

work_county.description: County where the user works. Wins over work-ZIP-derived counties when supplied.

work_state.description: Valid 50-state/DC code where the user works (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Lowercase is accepted and normalized.

work_zip.description: User's US 5-digit work ZIP or ZIP+4. Resolves to candidate work counties; when work_state is supplied, the crosswalk must agree with it.

worship.description: User's place of worship, resolved to a canonical organization.

worship_org_ids.description: Canonical worship-organization ids selected through resolve_eligibility_entities.

name: find_eligible_credit_unions

credit_union_id.description: Internal composite identifier of the credit union.

engine.description: Graph or legacy source for this verdict.

join_cost_usd.description: Up-front cost of a proven graph conditionally_eligible step, when known. Omitted for legacy-engine projections and every other status.

join_url.description: Where a proven graph conditionally_eligible step is completed, when known. Omitted for legacy-engine projections and every other status.

name.description: Credit union name, safe to show the user.

paths.description: Structured membership paths behind the verdict. Non-matches and non-winning alternatives retain no partial conditions, join action, URL, cost, or pending action labelled as matched.

publication.description: Exact immutable active generation evaluated for this entry.

activated_at.description: When this publication became serving authority.

proposal_coverage.description: Counts of source-page model proposals that were verified, published, or withheld; not a closed-world FOM attestation.

publication_id.description: Database identifier of the active publication.

ruleset_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the complete ordered rule set.

state.description: Two-letter state code of the credit union's headquarters.

status.description: eligible | conditionally_eligible | possibly_eligible | unknown. Reserved legacy negative values are normalized to unknown by MCP.

unknown_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for unknown, including `fom_completeness_unaffirmed` when the published corpus is not attested complete.

candidate_limit.description: Maximum unique candidates this search can accept for evaluation (currently 400).

candidate_set_truncated.description: True when the overall candidate cap or any source-query cap may have omitted additional institutions; absence from the response is never a negative verdict.

candidate_sources.description: Unique candidates accepted in deterministic priority order from each narrowing source.

association_graph.description: Candidates surfaced by the bounded association graph scan.

exact_graph.description: Candidates surfaced by exact graph-key matches.

legacy.description: Graph-less candidates surfaced by direct input-gated legacy geography or affinity matches.

legacy_open.description: Graph-less candidates added by the bounded broad open-to-anyone legacy fill.

open_graph.description: Candidates surfaced by open-to-anyone graph rules.

candidates_evaluated.description: How many credit unions in the bounded, prioritized candidate set were evaluated; not the number of institutions in the fleet.

conditionally_eligible.description: Credit unions joinable after one more step, with its cost when known.

counts.description: Size of each bucket within the bounded candidate set before the per-bucket `limit` is applied; not fleet-wide totals.

disclosure.description: Required disclosure that eligibility is guidance and the institution decides.

eligible.description: Credit unions with a verified membership path that already applies to this person.

limit.description: Maximum entries returned per bucket for this call.

missing_facts_truncated.description: True when a size cap dropped a question that could otherwise have been asked (3 per institution, 5 in the rollup, 20 unlock ids per rollup entry). The same honesty convention as candidate_set_truncated.

next_questions.description: Questions ranked across every institution evaluated, by how many each unlocks. Ask the top one to three, merge the answers into the same request body, and call again. Stop when this is empty, when the top entry`s unlocks_cu_count drops below 2, or after three turns. Absent when there is nothing to ask.

example_evidence_quote.description: One institution`s own words behind this question, as an illustration.

fact_field.description: The request field(s) an answer populates.

kind.description: The evaluator condition kind these questions share.

question.description: The generic phrasing of the question, as it should be put to a person.

unlocks_cu_count.description: How many evaluated institutions this one question would move out of unknown. The true total, even when the id list is capped.

unlocks_cu_ids.description: Institutions this question unlocks, capped at 20. unlocks_cu_count remains the true total.

note.description: Liability framing to surface alongside any eligibility claim.

possibly_eligible.description: Credit unions where a path may apply but a requirement could not be confirmed.

resolved.description: Canonical organizations and geography keys resolved from the supplied facts.

unanswerable.description: What no question can fix, and why. Do not ask the user about these. Absent when everything unresolved is askable.

condition_kinds.description: The evaluator condition kinds behind this entry, when any are known.

cu_count.description: How many evaluated institutions fall under this reason.

note.description: A deterministic sentence a UI can show verbatim.

reason.description: Why no question is emitted: no_rules, low_confidence_rules, unresolved_organization, unmodeled_condition, radius_centre_unidentified, radius_centre_ungeocoded, road_miles_unproven, or fom_completeness_unaffirmed.

unknown.description: Credit unions whose rules could not be decided from the supplied facts. Never an assertion of ineligibility.
